events.title: Trump used decoy plane with officials and press as human shields during Iranian threat
events.summary: The Washington Post reported that Trump hid in a catering container and was secretly shuttled to a different plane when leaving Turkey in response to what the administration claims was an Iranian assassination threat. While Trump switched planes, he left Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, White House deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller, and White House press corps members aboard Air Force One as a decoy. U.S. officials could not independently verify the Israeli-provided intelligence about the threat.
